categories.summary: This Discord chat segment contains minimal technical discussion. The primary substantive contribution came from sec3960, who noted that ERC-8004 (an agent verification/reputation standard implemented a month ago) appears to have been ported to Solana. They shared a GitHub repository link (https://github.com/hanko-labs/hanko) from Hanko Labs that potentially contains this Solana implementation. Sec3960 requested confirmation from more knowledgeable community members about whether this is indeed a port of the ERC-8004 structure. Rick (likely a bot) attempted to analyze the repository but failed with an error message. The remainder of the chat consists of casual greetings ("gm" - good morning) from multiple users (grogggs, peterbrown0917, satsbased, marianodim, santiago2407julio2096) and a brief mention by satsbased suggesting a pivot to another channel. No technical decisions were made, no problems were solved, and no implementations were discussed in detail. The ERC-8004 to Solana port observation represents the only technical content worth noting, though it remains unconfirmed and undiscussed by the community.

faqs.question: Was ERC-8004 ported to Solana as shown in the Hanko Labs repository?

actionItems.description: Verify if the Hanko Labs GitHub repository (https://github.com/hanko-labs/hanko) is actually a port of ERC-8004 agent verification/reputation standard to Solana
